title: Municipal places catalogue
body: The Ville de Paris municipal-places dataset catalogs municipal locations referenced by a dedicated Paris.fr application. The dataset describes categories such as parks, swimming pools, and libraries; its source records can contain operational details that must be checked at the source when currency matters.

title: Municipal-place provenance rule
body: Use the municipal-places dataset as a source of record-level provenance, not as proof of live opening hours, prices, or availability. A generated answer must cite the specific corpus record and identify uncertainty when the fixture has no dated operational detail.

title: Accessibility-augmented neighbourhood routes
body: Paris Data describes priority routes in Quartiers d’Accessibilité Augmentée as routes intended to connect accessible public facilities. The dataset is useful for a bounded accessibility discussion, but it is not a real-time accessibility or disruption feed.

title: Services connected by accessibility routes
body: The Quartiers d’Accessibilité Augmentée source describes routes to categories of public service including culture, libraries, leisure, green space, health, education, and early childhood services. The corpus does not infer that every route or venue is currently accessible in every circumstance.

title: Accessibility-route extension dataset
body: Paris Data also publishes a separate dataset for extensions and new accessibility-augmented routes. This fixture retains the source as a dated, licensed provenance record and does not make live route-status claims.

title: Transit-data licence boundary
body: Île-de-France Mobilités publishes reference transport data and accessibility or service data under documented open-data licences. This fixture records that provenance boundary only; it is not a substitute for a dated timetable, disruption, or accessibility-status source.

title: Louvre Museum
body: The Louvre is an art and archaeology museum in Paris. This corpus record does not state current exhibitions, tickets, or opening hours.

title: Musée d’Orsay
body: The Musée d’Orsay is a museum in Paris. This corpus record is for grounded identification only and does not state live visitor information.

title: Centre Pompidou
body: The Centre Pompidou is a multidisciplinary cultural centre in Paris. Current programming must be verified from a current source.

title: Musée de l’Orangerie
body: The Musée de l’Orangerie is an art gallery in the Tuileries Gardens in Paris. This record does not claim current collection display details.

title: Musée Rodin
body: The Musée Rodin is a museum in Paris devoted to the work of sculptor Auguste Rodin. This record does not make a live-access claim.

title: Musée Picasso
body: The Musée Picasso is a museum in Paris devoted to Pablo Picasso’s work. Current exhibition information is outside this corpus record.

title: Musée Carnavalet
body: The Musée Carnavalet is a museum of the history of Paris. This record provides a stable subject description rather than a current programme.

title: Petit Palais
body: The Petit Palais is an art museum in Paris. This record does not provide live opening hours or ticket availability.

title: Montmartre
body: Montmartre is a hill and historic district in Paris’s 18th arrondissement. This record is not an accessibility or route-status guarantee.

title: Le Marais
body: Le Marais is a historic district of Paris. The record provides geographic context and does not claim current venue availability.

title: Latin Quarter
body: The Latin Quarter is an area in Paris associated with higher education and student life. This record does not make a current recommendation.

title: Saint-Germain-des-Prés
body: Saint-Germain-des-Prés is a neighbourhood in Paris’s 6th arrondissement. This corpus record does not establish live commercial information.

title: Canal Saint-Martin
body: The Canal Saint-Martin is a canal in Paris. This record is not a live navigation, works, or access advisory.

title: Île de la Cité
body: Île de la Cité is an island in the River Seine in central Paris. This record gives location context only.

title: Île Saint-Louis
body: Île Saint-Louis is an island in the River Seine in Paris. This record does not make a current visitor-services claim.

title: Belleville
body: Belleville is a neighbourhood of Paris. This record intentionally avoids current restaurant, event, or safety claims.

title: French cuisine
body: French cuisine refers to culinary traditions and practices from France. This broad context is not a claim about a particular Paris restaurant.

title: Croissant
body: A croissant is a buttery, flaky French pastry. This record supplies cuisine context, not a recommendation of a particular bakery.

title: Baguette
body: A baguette is a long, thin loaf of French bread. This record does not rank or recommend a seller.

title: Macaron
body: A macaron is a sweet meringue-based confection. This corpus record does not claim current availability or ingredients at a venue.

title: Ratatouille
body: Ratatouille is a French vegetable stew. This record is culinary context only and not a restaurant recommendation.

title: French onion soup
body: French onion soup is a soup made with onions and stock. The corpus does not make a current menu claim.

title: Croque monsieur
body: A croque monsieur is a baked or grilled ham-and-cheese sandwich. This record is not a claim about any particular café.

title: Crêpe
body: A crêpe is a thin pancake of French origin. This record provides cuisine context rather than a venue recommendation.

title: Eiffel Tower
body: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris. This record does not state current access conditions.

title: Arc de Triomphe
body: The Arc de Triomphe is a triumphal arch in Paris. The record does not make a live visitor-access claim.

title: Notre-Dame de Paris
body: Notre-Dame de Paris is a medieval Catholic cathedral on Île de la Cité. This record does not state current visit arrangements.

title: Sainte-Chapelle
body: Sainte-Chapelle is a royal chapel in Paris. Current admission and security arrangements require a current source.

title: Les Invalides
body: Les Invalides is a complex of buildings and monuments in Paris. This record does not make a current museum-access claim.

title: Palais Garnier
body: The Palais Garnier is a historic opera house in Paris. Current performance schedules are outside the corpus.

title: Luxembourg Palace
body: The Luxembourg Palace is a palace in Paris that houses the French Senate. This record does not make a current access claim.

title: Place des Vosges
body: Place des Vosges is a planned square in Paris. This record provides historical place context only.

title: Panthéon

title: Catacombs of Paris
body: The Catacombs of Paris are underground ossuaries in Paris. The record does not provide a current access or safety advisory.
